headline: Cevdet Yılmaz Says There Is No Structural Problem in Capital Markets
summary: Vice President Cevdet Yılmaz said at the opening of MÜSİAD EXPO that there is no structural problem in capital markets. He added that markets would progress more strongly once limited problems are resolved.
why: Capital market confidence affects equity valuations, borrowing costs and foreign investment flows. Official statements on market structure influence investor sentiment.
